19. R—Q 3
20. Kt—Q 4
21. R—Kt 3
22. P—KR 4
23. P—R 5
B—Q 2
QR—QB 1
K—R 2
KR—Kt 1
Q—Kt 5

In order to pin the Knight and be ready to come back to either K 2 or B 1. Also to prevent QR—Kt 1. In reality nearly all these precautions are unnecessary, since White's attack amounts to nothing. Probably Black should have left aside all these considerations, and played Q—R 5 now, in order to follow it up with P—B 4, as he did later, but under less favourable circumstances.
